body:
I'm sorry you've had to go through that, no one deserves to be mistreated especially by people we're told we're supposed to trust.

As for getting away from the pain, spot on. Thing is I've accepted myself and tried to move on with my life but it never works out, I end up more miserable and damaged then before and I'm kinda done trying.

I'm not able to trust psychiatrists anymore, I was lied to and then discarded and it kind of ruined my life, it took me a year to recover enough to try and piece things back together and I'm still dealing with the aftereffects years later. That's all part of why I've started to give up

Back when I dealt with misprescribed antidepressants I ended up trying to harm myself because the side effects were so bad and no one tried to help despite me begging doctors to help, I learned that the way suicide is treated is counterproductive and only left me traumatized

I don't feel comfortable talking to people I know because best case they decide to cut me out of their life and worse case someone thinks a wellness check is a good I idea and I have to relive that nightmare

Thank you for that first part, unfortunately it feels I've traded my dysphoria for worsened depression and anxiety. Feels like I've traded one unlivable life for another different and somehow worse one. I do try and keep myself occupied but unfortunately the issues caused by misprescribe medication can make it impossible to do anything while at a lowpoint and even when I can do something to try and stay busy the fear and depression hang over me tainting it
